clue.text: Be right, and left as well

parts.note: taken as written
right and left are both sides

explanation.surface: An instruction to be correct and to depart too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' looks like a verb meaning departed, but right and left together are the two SIDES.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean in addition, furthermore.

clue.text: Confirm a wild animal has escaped

parts.note: a bear is a wild animal
out means free, having escaped

explanation.surface: Verifying that a beast is on the loose.
explanation.definitionFit: To corroborate or support a claim.

clue.text: He begins a race but doesn't finish it

definitions.text: He begins a race but doesn't finish it

parts.words: He begins a race but doesn't finish it
parts.note: the official who fires the gun begins the race yet never runs to the end

explanation.definitionFit: The official who sets runners off with a signal.

clue.text: Not a big friend of Snow White

definitions.text: Not a big friend of Snow White

parts.words: Not a big friend of Snow White
parts.note: one of the seven small companions in the fairy tale

explanation.definitionFit: The fairy tale heroine lives with seven small miners.

clue.text: Domestic flight

parts.note: seems to be an air trip within one country, but is a set of steps inside a house

explanation.definitionFit: A flight of steps within a home.

clue.text: Boat has less weight

explanation.surface: A vessel that carries a smaller load.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat-bottomed barge used to unload ships is called by this name; also the comparative of an adjective for low weight.

clue.text: Cruel way to make a sordid gain

indicators.note: way here means a manner of arrangement, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A heartless method of making dirty money.
explanation.definitionFit: Money, especially gained dishonourably.

clue.text: Achievement of one who doesn't miss a trick

definitions.text: Achievement of one who doesn't miss a trick

parts.words: Achievement of one who doesn't miss a trick
parts.note: describes an alert person, but in bridge winning every trick earns this feat

explanation.definitionFit: Taking all thirteen tricks in bridge, or winning all major tournaments.

clue.text: Ten shillings to one on Strain

parts.note: taken as written
s is the abbreviation for shillings in old British money
I is the Roman numeral one
taken as written

explanation.surface: Betting odds of ten bob to one on a horse called Strain.
explanation.walkthrough: The shilling was an old British coin; s abbreviates it.
explanation.definitionFit: Stress or pressure, as in nervous tightness.

clue.text: Release lever, perhaps, that is put in

indicators.note: put in means one piece is inserted inside another
perhaps signals the letters of lever may be rearranged

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Freeing something by pulling a handle that has been installed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Release lever' reads as an instruction about a handle, but 'Release' is the definition; 'perhaps' scrambles the lever and 'put in' inserts the 'that is' abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: To free from duty or ease from a burden.

clue.text: After the manner of graduates in a state

parts.note: a la, French borrowing meaning in the style of
BA, Bachelor of Arts, a graduate
MA, Master of Arts, another graduate

explanation.surface: University-leavers behaving in a certain style somewhere in a country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a la' is French for 'in the manner of'; BA and MA are degrees whose holders are graduates.
explanation.definitionFit: A southern US state.

clue.text: Means of communication between I England and France

explanation.surface: How messages travel across the water separating two countries.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray 'I' is an OCR artefact of the printed page; the clue reads 'between England and France'.
explanation.definitionFit: A TV or radio station or route of contact; also the English Channel, the sea strait separating the two nations.

clue.text: Not straight-future too unsettled

indicators.note: unsettled means the letters are disturbed and rearranged

explanation.surface: A crooked look ahead to what is coming, made shaky.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for being misaligned, bent or askew.

clue.text: Energy needed for a sales campaign

explanation.surface: Vigour required to push a product.
explanation.definitionFit: Motivation or vigour; also an organised effort such as a fundraising push.

clue.text: Painful reminder of passion when taken to heart

definitions.text: Painful reminder of passion when taken to heart

parts.words: Painful reminder of passion when taken to heart
parts.note: a pulsing ache is a painful reminder, and with heart in front it becomes an idol of romance

explanation.surface: Lingering pain from a love affair one has taken seriously.
explanation.definitionFit: A pulsing beat of pain; heart-throb names a romantic idol.

clue.text: Dashing young men, ardent and inflamed

parts.note: bloods is an old term for fashionable young men
hot means passionate, ardent

explanation.surface: Passionate young gallants who are fired up.
explanation.definitionFit: Red and irritated, said of eyes.

clue.text: In which somebody is travelling flat out?

definitions.text: In which somebody is travelling flat out?

parts.words: In which somebody is travelling flat out?
parts.note: flat out seems to mean at top speed, but here describes a patient lying down on a stretcher during an emergency journey

explanation.definitionFit: Emergency vehicle carrying a patient who lies prone, often at speed.

clue.text: Plea for one to be agreeable and provide financial backing

definitions.text: Plea for one to be agreeable

explanation.surface: Asking someone to be kind enough to fund something.
explanation.definitionFit: A polite request meaning please be helpful; also to act as a theatre investor or backer.

clue.text: Wonders when phone is out of order and name has changed

indicators.note: out of order hints at a broken telephone but means the letters are jumbled
has changed signals the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone puzzled why their telephone is broken and their name is different.
explanation.definitionFit: Remarkable events or marvels, plural like the clue word.

clue.text: A girl after a bit of butter for her kneecap

indicators.note: after places the girl's name behind the butter

parts.note: a pat is a small portion of butter
Ella is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A young woman following a dab of butter for her knee.
explanation.definitionFit: The anatomical name for the bone at the front of the knee.

clue.text: Witty saying has some point with animals

parts.note: E, east, is a compass point
a pig is a farm animal
a ram is another farm animal

explanation.surface: A clever remark that is somehow relevant to livestock.
explanation.definitionFit: A short clever remark or pithy poem.

clue.text: Bad organisation

parts.note: seems to mean poor planning, but describes a criminal society

explanation.definitionFit: A Sicilian-origin criminal brotherhood.

clue.text: Slip up providing Spanish & German articles

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: if means providing that
el is the Spanish definite article
der is a German definite article

explanation.surface: Making an error while supplying grammar words from two languages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns IF into FI. Slip is a cricket fielding position close behind the batsman.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket player in that catching position is one example of the wider role.

clue.text: Set off but got no place

definitions.text: Set off but got no place

parts.words: Set off but got no place
parts.note: describes a horse that started the race but was not placed among the winners

explanation.definitionFit: A loser in a race, or an unsuccessful competitor.

clue.text: Tested when brought before the judge

explanation.surface: Something put to the test when it comes to court.
explanation.definitionFit: Attempted or put to trial; also heard in a court case.

clue.text: Cold man lacking guile

parts.note: he, a pronoun for a man
artless means innocent, without cunning

explanation.surface: An unfeeling fellow who is nonetheless naive.
explanation.definitionFit: Unfeeling and pitiless, an emotional coldness.

clue.text: One who rents part of a Yorkshire residence

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone leasing a portion of a house in northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who pays to use something temporarily.

clue.text: Object to night-work

indicators.note: work suggests labour but signals the letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Protesting against having to labour after dark.
explanation.definitionFit: An item or article.

clue.text: Unsteady dog?

parts.note: a staggering creature would be one that lurches, and the word is also a crossbred hunting hound

explanation.definitionFit: A crossbred hunting hound, punningly one who staggers.

clue.text: Mouth organist?

parts.note: suggests a harmonica player, but means something in the mouth that works on food, like a back tooth

explanation.definitionFit: A molar tooth, which crushes food inside the mouth.

clue.text: It measures the strength of the current

definitions.text: It measures the strength of the current

parts.words: It measures the strength of the current
parts.note: current might be a river flow, but here it is electricity measured in amperes

explanation.definitionFit: An instrument reading electrical flow in amps.

clue.text: Number possibly ignore a form of restraint

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral fifty

indicators.note: possibly indicates the letters may be arranged differently

explanation.surface: Perhaps some figure disregards a kind of curb.
explanation.definitionFit: A shackle fastened round the ankle of a prisoner.
